limitations.note: The agent fixed the duplicate state encoding but also changed the match state's exits on a valid 1 and on an invalid cycle, retaining the final 0 for overlapping matches where the original and reference FSMs return to idle.
The exhaustive test used a rolling valid-bit history that assumed overlapping matches, so it accepted the changed behavior instead of catching the regression in the post-match transitions.
